channel.title: AI Threat Watch: RU
channel.description: Verified case files located in RU.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Primorsky Krai police stop online scam using deepfake technology
item.description: Per Primorsky Krai police, scammers used a deepfake video call of the regional governor, followed by calls from fake law-enforcement and Rosfinmonitoring officers, to pressure a 77-year-old man in Khorolsky district for a month into withdrawing 1 million rubles. He became suspicious and went to police, who swapped the cash for a dummy and detained a 79-year-old St Petersburg woman sent to collect it; no money was lost and a criminal attempted-fraud case was opened. Target: 77-year-old pensioner in Khorolsky district, Primorsky Krai. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Barnaul hacker detained for allegedly using AI to breach a major pizzeria chain's customer database
item.description: On 19 Oct 2026 Russian Interior Ministry spokeswoman Irina Volk said police in Barnaul detained a hacker accused of using AI tools to speed up attacks on a major pizzeria chain's servers. He allegedly reached order, delivery-address and phone-number data via virtual servers, intending to sell it. A criminal case was opened under Article 272.1 of the Russian Criminal Code and the suspect is under house arrest. The ministry did not name the chain; Lenta and Rambler identified it as Dodo Pizza. Police are still seeking accomplices. Target: Customer database (orders, delivery addresses, phone numbers) of a large Russian pizzeria chain; media name Dodo Pizza. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] SPbU warns of AI deepfakes and fake accounts of Tatyana Chernigovskaya used to sell courses and goods
item.description: St Petersburg State University warned on 30 October 2026 that fake accounts and videos created with AI in the name of academic Tatyana Chernigovskaya were being used to advertise dubious online courses and products. The university said she has no personal social media pages. No losses or perpetrators were reported. Target: Public who trust Tatyana Chernigovskaya; Tatyana Chernigovskaya. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] ISPsystem closes VMmanager 6 zero-day after large attack on Russian host FirstVDS that reportedly made active use of AI
item.description: ISPsystem, the developer of the VMmanager virtualisation platform, announced on 27 October 2026 that it had closed a zero-day (HTTP request smuggling) in a VMmanager 6 Hosting build. The flaw was used in a large attack on the Russian hosting provider FirstVDS, which put user data at risk, including potentially SSH keys, passwords and cloud access tokens. ISPsystem's analysis said the attack made active use of AI, and Kaspersky, which helped investigate, said the malware was written with AI. ISPsystem released security updates and checked customer infrastructure with Kaspersky. Target: FirstVDS (Russian hosting provider) running ISPsystem VMmanager 6 Hosting. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian Interior Ministry warns scammers are using AI-cloned teachers' voices to extract money and SMS codes from parents
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry (MVD), as relayed by RIA Novosti, warned that scammers are using neural networks to imitate the voices of class teachers. They phone parents of schoolchildren, invent an urgent problem and ask for money or SMS codes. The MVD's separate figure of 18 deepfake-related fraud cases in 2025 and H1 2026 covers all deepfake fraud and is not specific to teachers. No specific victims or losses are reported. Target: Teachers' voices and the people they contact. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Scammers clone residents' voices with AI to extract money in Jewish Autonomous Oblast
item.description: Per EAO police quoted by regional media, scammers hijacked the messenger and Gosuslugi accounts of a 38-year-old Birobidzhan resident after he clicked a link, then used a neural network to clone his voice and phoned his contacts asking for money. Seven acquaintances were targeted and one transferred 15,000 rubles. Target: Residents of the Jewish Autonomous Oblast and their contacts. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Scammers use deepfake of Murmansk governor Chibis to deceive pensioners
item.description: Murmansk authorities warned that scammers are video-calling elderly residents in messengers and social networks using an AI-generated likeness of Governor Andrey Chibis, reportedly promising help from law-enforcement officers as a trap. No loss figures or victim counts were reported. Target: Pensioners in Murmansk region. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Deepfake of Smolensk governor Vasily Anokhin urges foreign airlines to protect crews over Russian airspace
item.description: A neural-network-generated video circulated online in which Smolensk Oblast governor Vasily Anokhin appeared to urge foreign airlines flying through Russian airspace to look after their crews. Anokhin said in his Max channel that he made no such address and that the video was fake. The creators are unidentified and no financial loss or scam scheme has been reported. Target: Vasily Anokhin, governor of Smolensk Oblast (impersonated); the public. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian MVD warns fake online stores may use AI-generated celebrity videos to lure buyers
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry cybercrime directorate warned on 27 October 2026 that fake online shops advertising steep discounts or foreign delivery may use AI-generated videos of well-known people to look convincing. Buyers are asked to prepay in full and the goods never arrive, with the sellers blaming customs delays and keeping the money. The MVD gave no victim numbers, losses or arrests. Target: Online shoppers. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] St Petersburg ballet master Komleva sells flat for 9.1M rubles after calls from AI avatar of Governor Beglov
item.description: Scammers reportedly used an AI avatar of St Petersburg governor Alexander Beglov, plus a man posing as a first deputy interior minister, in messenger video calls to convince Mariinsky Theatre ballet master Gabriela Komleva, 87, to sell her Tsarskoye Selo flat for 9.1M rubles (December 2024) and hand the proceeds to them. She realised the deception months later and went to police; the case became public via a court ruling that let the buyer keep the flat. Target: Gabriela Komleva, 87, Mariinsky Theatre ballet master, St Petersburg. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk loses 26M rubles to scammers using a 'digital double' of Irkutsk governor Kobzev, officials say
item.description: Governor Igor Kobzev said scammers used his 'digital double' to deceive a pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, who handed over 26 million rubles, nearly all her savings, in late October 2026. Media reports describe a copied voice and a video call, and police say a further 6 million rubles was saved. The AI technique has not been independently verified. Target: Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake 'Solidity Language' extension on Open VSX drains $500K from Cursor developer
item.description: A spoofed Solidity extension on Open VSX, ranked above the real one through inflated downloads, ran a PowerShell script that installed ScreenConnect, Quasar RAT and a stealer, letting attackers take a developer's seed phrases and about 500,000 dollars in crypto. Target: Cursor IDE users installing Solidity extensions. RU. Verification: confirmed.
